resolvedQuestions.text: Minimum typed executable graph IR over 036 authority
Barrier, pipeline, reducer, and conflict-safe wave semantics
Eval verdicts as first-class control edges
Durable replay, effects, fencing, and human gates
Loops as typed subgraphs with independent convergence
Stable organization graphs and dynamic per-run work graphs

keyFindings.finding: Executable graph state is a projection; 036 remains transition and history authority.
Use a sealed versioned typed IR with explicit adapters and topology digest.
Reducers commit in graph order and branches fail closed with explicit skip propagation.
Readiness modes all/any/quorum/stream replace global barrier-only execution.
Parallel writes require declared write sets, conflict admission, isolation, and mutation-side fences.
GateVerdictV1 selects structural control edges and carries deterministic and evaluator evidence.
Gate authority is capped by blast radius and bound to blinded, negative-controlled certificates.
Ledger history, disposable checkpoints, and effect receipts have separate roles.
Human-gate decisions are versioned fenced commands with explicit reassignment and timeout events.
Loops become immutable child graphs with local state, budgets, convergence, and typed exits.
Research, review, improvement, and council use distinct typed subgraph profiles.
Parity is normalized authorized ledger-trace equivalence, not transcript or source-shape identity.
OrganizationGraphV1 governs stable role, capability, trust, budget, and handoff policy.
Work graphs pass proposal, deterministic compile, 036 authorization, seal, and versioned patch phases.
Evidence and knowledge graphs remain separate; query routing chooses lexical/vector/graph/hybrid.
Knowledge assertions are source-bound, bitemporal, contradiction-preserving, and identity-gated.
TraceEnvelopeV1 unifies replay, parity, trajectory eval, and hierarchical budget evidence.
GraphJustification rejects graph expansion without real independence/branching and measurable benefit.
Implementation order expands authority only after observable parity at each lower layer.
The next evidence class is shadow measurement; further corpus synthesis cannot prove runtime benefit.

ruledOutDirections: arbitrary code or prose labels as authoritative IR
parallel writes without write sets and fences
approval URL or timeout as authority
source imports or byte-identical prose as parity
